scope.description: Canadian investor-funder leads recovered from official mandates and portfolios after the live government-innovation-office gap proved saturated. Qualified leads proceed directly to private candidates; discovery context is not promoted into award or procurement claims.

source.title: Mistral Venture Partners official profile
source.locator: Official investment thesis, team, public contact, and portfolio overview
source.summary: Official Mistral Venture Partners material describes its investment approach, operating role, and public portfolio context used for this private-review candidate.

followUpQuestions: Confirm the preferred public legal name before publication.
Confirm whether a more specific Canada-based headquarters address should replace the current regional map placement.
reviewWarnings: The candidate maps investment focus to relevant technology coverage only; it does not claim a defence investment, procurement role, customer relationship, or endorsement.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Official organization material was reviewed for the investment mandate, Canadian operating context, and public contact or office information.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Invest in pre-seed and seed enterprise-AI founders in Canada and the United States, pairing capital with founder-operating experience and product-market-fit support.
